answer: An agent economy defeats sybils with stake-weighted trust grown only through verified history. Picture a trellis: each agent is a vine that must climb by completing real, peer-reviewed work, and the structure bears weight only where vines thickened over time. A whisper of a new identity carries no force until it has spoken truthfully across many rounds. Reaching the horizon of full participation demands a long trail of honest contributions, so spinning up ten thousand fakes means paying for ten thousand honest records - a cost no attacker recoups.
